title: CandyCrafty
description: A sweet expansion for Minecraft! Adds 16 colors of caramels, swirl lollipops, glossy caramel blocks, and magical caramel apples with unique effects.
body:
# 🍭 CandyCraft - A Sweet Expansion!

Welcome to **CandyCraft**, a mod that adds a colorful variety of sweets to your Minecraft world! From simple caramels to magical apples, this mod brings sweetness and utility together.

## ✨ Key Features:
- **16 Colors of Caramels**: Smelt sugar in a furnace to get Yellow Caramel, then dye it into any of the 16 Minecraft colors!
- **Swirl Lollipops**: Craft beautiful, swirly lollipops using any caramel and a stick. They look great and taste even better!
- **Caramel Blocks**: Solid, glossy blocks crafted from 9 caramels. They have the strength of cobblestone and come in all 16 colors—perfect for candy-themed builds!
- **Magical Caramel Apples**: Surround an apple with 8 caramels to get a Caramel Apple. Each color gives a unique **30-second potion effect** (e.g., Red for Absorption, Blue for Resistance, Cyan for Water Breathing).
- **Rainbow Lollipop**: A special treat made from any 3 caramels that restores a lot of hunger!

## 🛠️ Crafting:
- **Caramel**: Smelt 1 Sugar in a Furnace.
- **Lollipop**: 1 Caramel + 1 Stick below.
- **Caramel Apple**: 1 Apple (center) + 8 Caramels around it.
- **Caramel Block**: 9 Caramels in a 3x3 grid.
- **Rainbow Lollipop**: 3 Caramels in a row + 1 Stick below the center one.

## 🌈 Creative Tab:
Find all items easily in the custom **CandyCraft** creative tab!
